name: CryptBox
tagline: Encrypt files & folders with AES-256, self-decrypting archives and secure shred.
description: Encrypt and decrypt files and whole folders with AES-256-GCM and a passphrase (scrypt key derivation), create self-describing encrypted archives, and securely shred originals. Simple drag-in workflow with a clear security model. SecureVault's lightweight sibling — nothing is uploaded.
